# ADR-015: Use source scalar rotation for launch and retained-object queries

Status: chosen_for_orientation_reuse

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-state, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Route stationary launch and detached GetRotatedVector through the same existing generated scalar-angle adapter and reviewed rotation kernel as attached queries. Preserve the source angles already captured in metadata and retained snapshots.

## Rationale

Original Ball::GetRotatedVector uses its current scalar angles in the accepted old-orientation branch. The independent source-pinned Carbon/DirectX oracle exposed the removed-ball quaternion discrepancy at non-default yaw.

## Alternatives

Use Avian Rotation for launch or snapshot quaternion for a removed ball; duplicate matrix arithmetic.

## Consequences

Eighteen source cases match all launch, attached-query and detached-query lanes. Other platform/math/dynamic-orientation branches and required proofs remain open.
